description: This file implements the Controller class for managing IPC clients within the Rialto server manager. It handles creating, removing, and performing actions on clients, such as setting state, configuration, ping, and log levels, using thread-safe mechanisms.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Manages IPC clients for session server communication, providing thread-safe methods to create, remove, and perform actions on clients.

methods.name: Controller
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Controller with a session server app manager.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new IPC client for a given server ID and socket, returning success status.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes the IPC client associated with the specified server ID.

methods.name: performSetState
methods.description: Sets the session server state for a specific client identified by server ID.

methods.name: performSetConfiguration
methods.description: Configures a client with initial state, socket name, display name, resource limits, and permissions.

methods.name: performPing
methods.description: Sends a ping to a specific client identified by server ID.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets logging levels for all managed clients.
